items.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
items.feed_excerpt: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.

items.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
items.feed_excerpt: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

items.title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
items.feed_excerpt: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

items.title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
items.feed_excerpt: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.

items.title: Agility is the first pure humanoid robot company on the stock market. Are you buying?
items.feed_excerpt: Agility arrives on the Nasdaq today as the first publicly traded pure-play humanoid robotics company.

items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027

items.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots

items.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar

items.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
items.feed_excerpt: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

items.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots

items.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027

items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M

items.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web

items.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
items.feed_excerpt: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

items.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
items.feed_excerpt: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K scale up its microwave-plasma battery material manufacturing process.

items.title: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku
items.feed_excerpt: A few months after DOJ investigators were probing the deal, Fox just completed its $22B acquisition of the streaming giant Roku.

items.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO

items.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop

items.title: The Duo apps are coming, says Apple

items.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
